shots.name: Mutated Flipper (upper left)
shots.notes: An inverted upper flipper on the left side; it feeds the outer loop.

shots.name: Fusion Core Pop Bumper
shots.notes: The single pop bumper; every hit charges the fusion core.

shots.name: Hacking Target
shots.notes: Stand-up beside the left ramp: mystery (hacking) and extra ball.

shots.name: Pip-Boy Shot
shots.notes: The shot directly under the Pip-Boy.

shots.name: Left Orbit
shots.notes: The ramp-style lane just right of the Pip-Boy.

shots.name: Left Loop
shots.notes: The shot just left of the center ramp; the companion and stimpak calls name it the center loop.

shots.name: Center Ramp (Vault)
shots.notes: Leads to the vault door at the back.

shots.name: Nuka-Cola Spinner
shots.notes: A bottle-cap spinner that the game lowers into play and raises again.

shots.name: Right Scoop
shots.notes: Starts quests and side quests, opens Sundries, loots, and upgrades your weapon.

shots.name: Outer Loop
shots.notes: The long wasteland loop, shot from the mutated upper flipper.

shots.name: Fat Man Launcher
shots.notes: A multi-axis launcher that fires the ball at a lit target; aim is fired with the action button.

shots.name: Gallery Targets
shots.notes: Two targets; the middle one flips to its other face after every hit.

shots.name: Vault Stand-ups
shots.notes: Three stand-up targets in the lower vault playfield.

goals.title: Skill Shot -- Cap Stash
goals.summary: Time the launch so the ball rolls over the flashing Nuka-Cola inlane, then rip the spinner while it is down.
goals.reward: 3M base plus a value per spin and a few seconds of ball save; each repeat raises both

steps.detail: Watch the Nuka-Cola light on the right inlane and launch so the ball crosses it while it flashes.
Catching it lit drops the Nuka-Cola spinner into play for only a few seconds.
Fire straight from the right flipper -- every spin adds to the award and the spinner pops back up fast.

goals.title: Pick Lucy, Maximus or The Ghoul
goals.summary: Before the first launch, the flipper buttons choose who you play as. Each character carries a perk and two S.P.E.C.I.A.L. bonuses.
instructions: Before plunging ball one, tap the flipper buttons to cycle through the three characters.
Lucy: vaults are friendlier -- easier letters and longer timers -- plus +1 Perception and +1 Luck.
Maximus: power armor burns slower (two extra seconds per fusion-core level) plus +1 Strength and +1 Agility.
The Ghoul: radiation can't hurt him -- radroaches build HP instead -- plus +1 Endurance and +1 Charisma.
Each character also has side modes of their own, so the pick shapes more than your stats.

goals.title: Fill Up on HP and Start a Quest
goals.summary: Quests run on HP as their clock. Eat at the yellow Pip-Boy shot until you have at least 50 HP, then take the right scoop.
goals.reward: A quest mode; finishing it awards a Legendary Weapon

steps.detail: Each lit food shot under the Pip-Boy adds HP, and repeats keep adding more. Early on the right ramp feeds you too.

steps.action: Change the quest if you like
steps.detail: With a quest lit, the Junk target rolls the selection to the next one.
The blinking QUESTS insert is the one you'll get. One HP is one second of quest time, up to 100.

goals.title: Wedding Day
goals.summary: A two-ball quest. On Premium/LE the lower vault joins in: main-playfield shots light the vault's shots and vice versa, and making every main-playfield shot opens the vault for the super. On Pro, blue shots light yellow shots, and yellow shots build toward the super.
goals.reward: Super jackpot and a Legendary Weapon

steps.detail: Pick Wedding Day as the lit quest and take the scoop.
Count the red inserts down and hit the Deathclaw when FIRE! lights to add a ball.
On Premium/LE, the vault door opens once the super is lit -- shoot through it for the super, which also finishes the quest.

goals.requiresNote: Start it at the right scoop as the queued quest, with at least 50 HP

goals.title: Radscorpion Attack
goals.summary: Any lit shot lights the center jump ramp at double value, and extra shots grow it. Land four jumps and the final blow lights -- on Premium/LE you deliver it with the Fat Man at the lit target.
goals.reward: Mode total and a Legendary Weapon

steps.detail: Each jump starts at 500K plus 250K per shot made. After the fourth, the final blow lights.

goals.requiresNote: Start it at the right scoop as the queued quest, with at least 50 HP

goals.title: The Kings
goals.summary: A two-ball quest built on combos. Every lit shot is a jackpot; chaining them starts a killing spree and raises the multiplier. Three sprees -- or a maxed multiplier -- light the super jackpot.
goals.reward: Super jackpot and a Legendary Weapon

steps.detail: Any lit shot scores a jackpot; flowing one straight into the next starts a killing spree.
Each spree adds 1x to the multiplier and pays a multiplied jackpot.
When FIRE! lights under the Deathclaw, one more bash brings in another ball.

goals.requiresNote: Start it at the right scoop as the queued quest, with at least 50 HP

goals.title: Mind Control
goals.summary: Lit ramps drop the Nuka-Cola spinner for a short window; rip it enough times to pass each of three tests.
goals.reward: Test values and a Legendary Weapon

steps.detail: Any lit ramp drops the spinner for a few seconds.
Spins count toward the current test; the second test asks for 50 spins.
Keep relighting the spinner with ramps until all three tests are done.

goals.requiresNote: Start it at the right scoop as the queued quest, with at least 50 HP

goals.title: NOVAC
goals.summary: A ramp mode. Lit ramps score 2M plus 250K per shot, an upper loop raises the multiplier on your next ramp, and six or more mode shots light the Pip-Boy finish.
goals.reward: Double-value finish and a Legendary Weapon

steps.detail: Every lit ramp scores the mode value.
Six or more mode shots light the final shot.
The finish pays double the current shot value.

goals.requiresNote: Start it at the right scoop as the queued quest, with at least 50 HP

goals.title: Find the Target
goals.summary: Search four different yellow shots to locate the target, then hit whichever shot's insert blinks faster than the rest. Other shots raise its value first if you want. Another phase follows once it's hit.
goals.reward: Mode total and a Legendary Weapon

steps.detail: Each search must be a different shot -- repeats don't count.
Four searches reveal where the target is.

goals.requiresNote: Start it at the right scoop as the queued quest, with at least 50 HP

goals.title: Spell VAULT and Open the Vault
goals.summary: Collect VAULT letters at the lit shots to light Open Vault on the center ramp. Premium/LE sends you into the lower vault for a vault mode; Pro plays Find the Lunchbox.
goals.reward: A lunchbox: odd ones start Vault Multiball, even ones give a Legendary Weapon

steps.detail: Any shot showing a lit VAULT letter insert pays a letter; grab whichever ones are on.
Premium/LE: the ball is held while the door swings open -- shoot through it to start a vault mode. Pro: bash the door again to start Find the Lunchbox.

goals.title: Play a Vault Mode
goals.summary: Premium/LE only. Inside the vault, the lower playfield's three stand-ups and loop are the whole mode. The vault number shown as the door opens tells you which mode you got.
goals.reward: A lunchbox

steps.detail: Most vault modes ask for hits on the three stand-ups -- gather supplies, fight raiders, collect parts -- before the loop.
Finishing the mode at the loop collects a lunchbox.

goals.requiresNote: Opening the vault with VAULT spelled

goals.title: Find the Lunchbox (Pro)
goals.summary: Pro only. After opening the vault, several shots light blue. Hit any one to find a lunchbox -- that shot drops out of later rounds -- then open it at the scoop.
goals.reward: A lunchbox

steps.detail: Once you've found it at a blue shot, the scoop opens it and pays the reward.

goals.requiresNote: Opening the vault with VAULT spelled

goals.title: Deathclaw Multiball
goals.summary: Cripple the Deathclaw's four limbs with timed bashes to start its multiball. There are three, played in order. The first has you build the jackpot on red shots and cash it at the Deathclaw; the second has you charge your weapon on red shots and switches before each jackpot.
goals.reward: Jackpots and supers; a weapon upgrade unlocks the next Deathclaw

steps.detail: The four inserts under the toy sweep back and forth -- the lit one is the limb you'll hit. When all four and FIRE! flash, the next bash starts it.
In the first one, for 20 seconds every red-lit shot -- not just this one -- raises the jackpot from its 2M base.
For 12 seconds, bash to collect; combo bashes stack a multiplier and enough jackpots light supers.

goals.requiresNote: The second and third Deathclaw multiballs each need a weapon upgrade first

goals.title: Wasteland Multiball
goals.summary: Hit the 3-bank to earn mini-nukes and load them with the left loop, then clear the shooting gallery -- the Fat Man's upper gallery on Premium/LE, the same 3-bank fired from the left flipper on Pro. Clearing it starts the multiball: wipe out enemy waves at lit shots to light the super.
goals.reward: 3M+ jackpots; the super is 15M times the wave number, plus 2.5M for every jackpot collected

steps.detail: A 3-bank hit earns a mini-nuke.
The left loop loads the Fat Man on Premium/LE; on Pro the ball feeds the left flipper instead.
Pro: shoot the lit 3-bank stand-up from the left flipper. Premium/LE: the Fat Man fires at the upper gallery instead (see Fat Man: Clear the Gallery). Clearing it starts the multiball.

goals.title: Fat Man: Clear the Gallery
goals.summary: Premium/LE only. The Fat Man fires the loaded ball at the upper shooting gallery: a spinner and two targets. During the multiball, the red Pip-Boy shot loads it for the super.
goals.reward: Gallery hits toward Wasteland Multiball, then its super jackpot

steps.detail: Aim at the lit gallery shot and press the action button to fire.
When the spinner is lit, a shot through it counts.
The middle target flips to its other side after every hit.
Once enough kills light the super, the red Pip-Boy shot loads the Fat Man to fire it at the blinking 3-bank light.

goals.title: Vault Multiball
goals.summary: A three-ball multiball from your first lunchbox. The jackpot marches left to right, one shot per collect, and a final lit shot follows the right orbit; clear the march and the super lights at the vault.
goals.reward: 2M+ jackpots and a vault super jackpot

steps.detail: The faster-blinking blue shot with its VAULT insert lit is the jackpot; other blue shots build its value.
The jackpot moves one shot to the right each time you collect it.
The ramp-style lane just right of the Pip-Boy.
The shot just left of the center ramp.
Each jackpot is 2M plus 500K for every one before it.
One more jackpot shot lights after this -- take whichever is flashing.
Premium/LE: go past the vault door and finish the stand-ups and loop below. Pro: bash the door.

goals.requiresNote: Your first lunchbox from the vault (then every odd-numbered one)

goals.title: Radio Modes
goals.summary: Build the radio signal at the radio tower target. At full strength the music-note inserts light up in different colors -- each color is a different song. Hit the note shot showing the color you want; the song's length is the mode timer.
goals.reward: Radio jackpots once enough shots are made during the song

steps.detail: The signal meter sits top-left on the backbox display. Once it's full, pick your song by hitting the music-note shot in that song's color. The timer runs the whole song and can't be paused by holding the ball.

goals.title: Cap Stash and the Sundries Shop
goals.summary: Light both Nuka-Cola inlanes to light the Cap Stash, roll the flashing one to drop the spinner and rip it for caps, then spend caps at the scoop.
goals.reward: Caps to buy fusion cores, stimpaks, junk and more

steps.detail: Both inlane lights qualify the Cap Stash.
A tap of a flipper button slides the flashing Nuka-Cola to the other inlane.
The spinner stays down while it keeps spinning, then rises after a pause.
When the shop is lit, up to four items are offered. You can try to steal one -- if you're caught, escape through the right orbit within 10 seconds or Mr. Handy takes every cap you have.

goals.title: Upgrade Your Weapon
goals.summary: Gather enough junk and take the scoop to upgrade your weapon. Each level adds a permanent playfield multiplier and bonus multiplier.
goals.reward: +0.2x playfield and +1x bonus per level; unlocks the next Deathclaw Multiball

steps.detail: The Junk target (when lit), looting and the shop all supply junk.
Level 2 takes any five junk; later levels ask for more, including rare junk.

goals.title: Suit Up in Power Armor
goals.summary: Charge the fusion core at the pop bumper, then hold the action button to put on power armor for a timed 2x playfield.
goals.reward: +1x playfield multiplier while the core lasts, added to your weapon multiplier

steps.detail: Every pop hit fills the core lights beside the bumper; Sundries sells cores too. Once it holds the minimum charge, a long press of the action button puts the armor on -- hold again to take it off and save the rest.

goals.title: Recruit a Trusty Companion
goals.summary: When the yellow companion inserts flash, make the left ramp, left loop and right orbit to recruit a companion. Each has an always-on perk and a button ability.
goals.reward: Victor, Protectron, Dogmeat or Mr. Handy -- each with a passive perk and an action-button ability

steps.detail: Any order works -- just make all three while the yellow inserts flash.
This is the loop just left of the center ramp.
Once recruited, a short press of the action button fires your companion's ability.

goals.title: Light the Stimpak Outlane Save
goals.summary: When the same three shots flash white instead of yellow, making them lights an outlane ball save.
goals.reward: Outlane ball save

steps.detail: Same three shots as the companion -- the insert color tells you which award is lit.
Any order works.
The third shot lights the outlane save.

goals.title: Radroaches and Radaway
goals.summary: Kill the slowly blinking radroach at a stand-up, then stay off the solid-lit ones -- they're radiation pools that cut your max HP. A green ramp shot then offers radaway to fix it.
goals.reward: Points, loot, and radaway toward the Radaway Hurry-Up

steps.detail: Only the slow-blinking stand-up is a live radroach; another spawns elsewhere.
A new radroach spawns at one of the other stand-ups after each kill.
A solid light is a radiation pool -- hitting it again lowers your max HP.
A green ramp shot is a radaway hurry-up: faster is worth more, and it restores lost max HP.
After a kill, the scoop loots 2-3 random rewards -- caps, Nuka-Cola, junk, sometimes a legendary.

goals.title: Radaway Hurry-Up
goals.summary: After three radaways, the green Pip-Boy shot starts the hurry-up. Make all three ramps, then cash at the outer loop from the mutated flipper -- as many times as you can in 10 seconds.
goals.reward: A repeatable jackpot for 10 seconds

steps.detail: Shoot the flashing green Pip-Boy shot.
The three ramps can come in any order.
Two down, one to go.
All three ramps light the jackpot.
Repeat the loop from the mutated flipper as often as you can for 10 seconds.

goals.title: Glowing Radroach
goals.summary: Kill all four radroaches to spawn a glowing one. On Premium/LE you load the Fat Man and hit the lower-right radroach as the launcher sweeps past it.
goals.reward: 20M+ per glowing radroach

steps.detail: The launcher points near the lower-right radroach and slowly swings.
A hit pays 20M plus 10M for each glowing radroach before it.

goals.title: Wasteland Loops and Side Quests
goals.summary: Shoot the outer loop from the mutated flipper to explore and pick up wasteland items. Loops are the main way to light Nuka-Cola Quantum -- collected at the shot behind the mutated flipper, it doubles XP for a short time -- and enough items light side quests at the scoop.
goals.reward: Side quests (Filly, Gulper, Super Duper Mart)

steps.detail: Each trip advances you across the wasteland.
With enough items and over 50 HP, the scoop starts the next side quest. After each phase you can cash out at the scoop or keep going for more time.

goals.title: Hack a Terminal
goals.summary: The stand-up beside the left ramp is a mystery award when its white light is on. It's also where lit extra balls are collected.
goals.reward: Mystery award; extra ball when lit

steps.detail: Hacking can fail, or pay 10M, XP and more.
Radroach kills light extra ball -- the 4th, then the 25th.

goals.title: Level Up S.P.E.C.I.A.L.
goals.summary: Your seven S.P.E.C.I.A.L. stats each give a perk for the rest of the game. The Pip-Boy screen shows what the next level will do.
instructions: Character choice gives two stats a head start; bobbleheads from Sundries add more.

Strength makes junk easier; Endurance lengthens ball save and doubles item progress; Charisma discounts the shop and lets the flippers choose quests; Intelligence makes the Fat Man and radio jackpots easier.
Perception at its second level lets the right flipper slide the stimpak between the outlanes.
Agility makes VATS and weapon upgrades cheaper; Luck brings more caps and better junk.
Signed in with Insider Connected, your S.P.E.C.I.A.L. progress builds from game to game, and raising every stat to 10 unlocks new modes for each character.

goals.title: Use VATS
goals.summary: Every switch fills the AP bar on the backbox. When it's full, VATS takes a shooting-gallery target for you -- choose it with the flipper buttons.
goals.reward: A free shooting-gallery hit toward Wasteland Multiball

steps.detail: On Pro, VATS spots one of the 3-bank stand-ups; on Premium/LE it aims the Fat Man for you.

achievements.title: Bottle Cap Collector
achievements.desc: Make the Cap Stash skill shot.

achievements.title: Door's Open
achievements.desc: Spell VAULT and open the vault.

achievements.title: Nuked From Orbit
achievements.desc: Clear the shooting gallery to start Wasteland Multiball.

achievements.title: Vault Dweller
achievements.desc: Score the Vault Multiball super jackpot.

drills.title: Cap Stash Timing
drills.text: Practice the launch until the ball crosses the right Nuka-Cola light while it flashes, then go straight to the spinner from the right flipper.

drills.title: Mutated Flipper Loops
drills.text: Feed the mutated flipper and shoot the outer loop again and again. It drives wasteland items, Quantum, and the Radaway Hurry-Up cash-in.

drills.title: Deathclaw Timing
drills.text: From a cradle, watch the sweeping limb lights and bash only when an uncrippled limb is lit. On Premium/LE a crippled limb throws the ball back at you.

drills.title: Companion Trio
drills.text: Shoot the left ramp, left loop and right orbit in any order. The same three shots recruit companions and light the stimpak save.

drills.title: Vault March
drills.text: Shoot the vault-multiball jackpot march in order, left ramp to right orbit, until you can do it without a miss.

actionButton.label: Action Button
actionButton.how: Fallout's action button does two jobs, set by how long you hold it. A short press fires your Trusty Companion's ability; a long press puts on (or takes off) power armor. On Premium/LE it also fires the Fat Man.

uses.what: Short press to use their ability -- Victor drops the spinner, Protectron spots radaway, Dogmeat grabs lit junk, Mr. Handy spots a Deathclaw shot.
Hold to suit up in power armor for a timed 2x playfield; hold again to take it off and save the charge.
Fire the launcher at the lit gallery target or 3-bank light.

howItPlays.objective: Fallout is a Keith Elwin role-playing game: pick Lucy, Maximus or The Ghoul, keep your HP up, and run quests, vault trips and multiballs while collecting caps, junk and legendary weapons that make you stronger as the game goes on.
loop: Eat at the yellow Pip-Boy shot to raise HP, because HP is the clock for every quest.
With 50 HP or more, start the lit quest at the right scoop; finishing one earns a Legendary Weapon.
Spell VAULT at the lit letter shots and break into the vault at the center ramp for lunchboxes and Vault Multiball.
In between, gather caps, junk and fusion cores so you can upgrade your weapon and wear power armor -- both multiply everything else.

lights.name: QUEST Inserts
lights.lit: The yellow QUESTS inserts on both sides of the playfield are the main quests; the BLINKING one is the next quest the scoop will start. The yellow Pip-Boy shot is lit while food is on offer.
lights.flashing: The blinking quest insert is the one queued for the scoop.

control.effect: the flipper buttons pick which quest is queued
control.when: only once Charisma reaches level 2 -- before that, hitting the Junk target is how you swap the queued quest

lights.then: Get above 50 HP at the Pip-Boy shot, then hit the right scoop to start the blinking quest. HP becomes its timer, one second per point. Finish it for a Legendary Weapon -- a permanent perk for the rest of the game.

lights.name: VAULT Letters
lights.lit: A lit VAULT letter insert marks a shot that will give you the next letter; once all five are in, OPEN VAULT lights on the center ramp.
lights.then: Take the lit letter shots until VAULT is spelled, then shoot the center ramp. Premium/LE holds the ball, swings the door open and sends you through to a vault mode in the lower playfield; Pro plays Find the Lunchbox. Every lunchbox pays: odd ones start Vault Multiball, even ones give a Legendary Weapon.

lights.name: Deathclaw Limbs + FIRE!
lights.lit: The four limb inserts under the Deathclaw sweep left and right; the lit one is the limb your next bash will cripple. Crippled limbs stay crippled.
lights.flashing: All four plus FIRE! flashing means the multiball is ready -- the next bash starts it.
lights.then: Time each bash for an uncrippled limb (on Premium/LE, hitting a crippled one fires the ball back at you). Cripple all four, then bash once more for Deathclaw Multiball. Upgrading your weapon unlocks the next Deathclaw Multiball.

lights.name: Nuka-Cola Inlanes
lights.lit: Each Nuka-Cola inlane light stays on once you roll through it. With both lit, the Cap Stash is ready and one of them FLASHES.
lights.flashing: The flashing Nuka-Cola is the lane that drops the spinner.

control.effect: a tap of a flipper button moves the flashing Nuka-Cola to the other inlane so you can put it under the ball
control.when: once both inlanes are lit and Cap Stash is ready

lights.then: Roll the flashing inlane and the Nuka-Cola spinner drops. Rip it from the right flipper for caps; it stays down while it keeps spinning and rises after a pause. Caps buy fusion cores, stimpaks, radaway and junk at Sundries.

lights.name: Companion / Stimpak Inserts
lights.lit: These three shots carry flashing inserts for two different awards: YELLOW is a Trusty Companion and WHITE is the stimpak outlane save.
lights.then: Make all three while yellow flashes to recruit a companion (each has a perk plus an action-button ability). Make them while white flashes to light an outlane ball save.

lights.name: Radroach Targets
lights.lit: A SLOW-BLINKING radroach light is a live radroach. A SOLID one is a pool of radiation left by a kill.
lights.then: Kill the blinking one for points and loot at the scoop -- another spawns somewhere else. Stay off the solid ones: they give you RAD, which cuts your max HP until you drink radaway. Kill all four for a glowing radroach.

lights.name: Green Radaway Shots
lights.lit: A green arrow on a ramp means radaway is on offer after you've taken RAD. Its value counts down, so sooner pays more.
lights.then: Drink it to restore max HP. Three radaways flash the green Pip-Boy shot for the Radaway Hurry-Up: make all three ramps, then repeat the outer loop from the mutated flipper for 10 seconds.

lights.name: Fusion Core Meter
lights.lit: The column of lights next to the pop bumper is your fusion core charge; it climbs as you hit the bumper and drains while power armor is on.

control.effect: hold to put power armor on, hold again to take it off and save what's left
control.when: once the core has the minimum charge

lights.then: Suit up when a good shot sequence is coming: armor adds +1x to the playfield on top of your weapon multiplier until the core runs out.

lights.name: Music-Note Inserts
lights.lit: When the radio signal is at full strength, the music-note inserts light up in different colors. Each color is a different song, and so a different radio mode.
lights.then: Hit the music-note shot showing the color of the song you want to start it, then make enough shots during the song to light the radio jackpot. The song length is the timer and you can't stop it by holding the ball.

howItPlays.laneChangeNote: Once both Nuka-Cola inlanes are lit, a tap of a flipper button moves the flashing Nuka-Cola light to the other inlane. Put it under the ball, roll through, and the Nuka-Cola spinner drops so you can rip it for caps.

scoring.text: Start with the Cap Stash skill shot, eat at the Pip-Boy shot and start a quest. Charge the fusion core on the pop bumper and recruit a companion so you have armor and an ability ready.
Upgrade your weapon with junk for a permanent multiplier, cripple the Deathclaw for its multiball, and spell VAULT to work through vault modes and lunchboxes.
Vault Multiball and Wasteland Multiball are the big payoffs -- play them with power armor on and an upgraded weapon so every jackpot is multiplied.
